arch_opening: There is an update available — version 1.4.0. It is about cost and focus: smaller handoff files, a cheap helper for logs, the right model and effort per role, and me reminding you when a fresh session pays off. None of it is mandatory. I will check your files and tell you what applies.

changes.title: Model aliases instead of pinned IDs
changes.what_changed: Briefings use the aliases opus, sonnet, haiku, fable instead of outdated pinned model IDs.
changes.user_impact_plain: Briefings use the aliases opus, sonnet, haiku, fable instead of outdated pinned model IDs.
changes.user_decision: Your role files pin old model IDs. Replace them with aliases?

changes.title: One handoff file per round
changes.what_changed: Each Builder/Reviewer round writes its own REVIEW-REQUEST-[ID].md and REVIEW-FEEDBACK-[ID].md. Finished steps move to handoff/archive/. Checkpoint stays under 80 lines. Fresh agent every round; Builder stops at ~80 tool calls.
changes.user_impact_plain: Each Builder/Reviewer round writes its own REVIEW-REQUEST-[ID].md and REVIEW-FEEDBACK-[ID].md. Finished steps move to handoff/archive/. Checkpoint stays under 80 lines. Fresh agent every round; Builder stops at ~80 tool calls.
changes.how_to_assess: Check the size of handoff/REVIEW-FEEDBACK.md, handoff/BUILD-LOG.md and handoff/SESSION-CHECKPOINT.md. Over ~300 lines (checkpoint: 80) means the change pays off now.
changes.user_decision: Want me to update the role files and do a one-time archive pass over handoff/?

changes.title: Reviewer on high effort, reviewing the diff
changes.what_changed: The Reviewer runs with effort high and reviews the git diff range from the request.
changes.user_impact_plain: The Reviewer runs with effort high and reviews the git diff range from the request.
changes.how_to_assess: Read the Reviewer spin-up prompt in the Architect role file.
changes.user_decision: Update the Reviewer briefing and REVIEWER.md?

changes.title: Triage role (Hank) on Haiku
changes.what_changed: A cheap helper reads long logs, test output and search sweeps and writes a 40-line summary.
changes.user_impact_plain: A cheap helper reads long logs, test output and search sweeps and writes a 40-line summary.
changes.how_to_assess: Check whether TRIAGE.md exists in the project root.
changes.user_decision: Add TRIAGE.md and the Triage section to the Architect role file?

changes.title: Architect proposes fresh session and /compact
changes.what_changed: After each Deploy Gate and before long rounds, the Architect proposes a fresh session or /compact.
changes.user_impact_plain: After each Deploy Gate and before long rounds, the Architect proposes a fresh session or /compact.
changes.how_to_assess: Check the Architect role file for a Context Hygiene section.

changes.title: Builder effort per round
changes.what_changed: The brief carries an Effort line (medium for mechanical rounds, high for logic).
changes.user_impact_plain: The brief carries an Effort line (medium for mechanical rounds, high for logic).
changes.how_to_assess: Check the brief template for an Effort line.

changes.title: Advisor on Fable with decision memos
changes.what_changed: For hard decisions the Architect writes a short memo and asks a one-off Advisor on Fable, instead of switching its own session. Two failed reviews of a step trigger a re-plan.
changes.user_impact_plain: For hard decisions the Architect writes a short memo and asks a one-off Advisor on Fable, instead of switching its own session. Two failed reviews of a step trigger a re-plan.
changes.how_to_assess: Check whether ADVISOR.md and handoff/decisions/ exist.

changes.title: Models and effort in manifest.md
changes.what_changed: manifest.md gets a Models section — one place for model and effort per role.
changes.user_impact_plain: manifest.md gets a Models section — one place for model and effort per role.
changes.how_to_assess: Read manifest.md for a '## Models' section.
changes.user_decision: Add the Models section with the defaults?

changes.title: Optional Specialist Reviewer
changes.what_changed: A domain reviewer with a reading duty on named sources and a veto, for projects whose rules live outside the code.
changes.user_impact_plain: A domain reviewer with a reading duty on named sources and a veto, for projects whose rules live outside the code.
changes.how_to_assess: Ask whether the project depends on external rules (regulation, standard, documented product behavior, API contract).
changes.user_decision: Want to configure a Specialist Reviewer now, later, or not at all?

changes.title: Spend reports
changes.what_changed: The Architect logs reported agent usage and tells you when the running estimate passes a threshold from manifest.md.
changes.user_impact_plain: The Architect logs reported agent usage and tells you when the running estimate passes a threshold from manifest.md.
changes.how_to_assess: Read manifest.md for a '## Budget' section.
changes.user_decision: Want spend notices? Give me an amount.
